subject: [PATCH v3 3/3] mm/zswap: preserve the workingset shadow across writeback

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue in the zswap compression algorithm where the workingset shadow is lost during writeback, leading to inaccurate anon refault/workingset accounting. To fix this, the patch preserves the workingset shadow within zswap by parking it in the zswap tree at writeback time, ensuring it outlives the writeback buffer folio. The parked shadow is then handled when the buffer meets one of three fates: swap-in, reclaim, or slot free. This approach ensures accurate accounting for written-back data and fixes a bug introduced by commit aae466b0052e.
